lead: A Samba user's password cannot be changed the day it was set.
body: The domain's minimum password age refuses `changePassword` right after `setPassword` with `0000052D ... password is too young to change`, which reads as `PasswordPolicy`. Write `pwdLastSet = 0` between the two, as `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs` and `tests/conformance/core/ldap-set-password.nvst` do. A second bind with the same block and password reuses the pooled connection, so it cannot show that an old password stopped working.
